raw.rationale: This is likely a dopamine antagonist antipsychotic (e.g., haloperidol or similar) with broad off-target activity including hERG and calcium channels, but at 2.5 µM for 5 days it is expected to cause mostly non-selective cytotoxicity across adherent cancer lines; selective lineage killing is unlikely except possibly in CNS-derived lines due to dopamine receptor expression, though PRISM CNS lines are not primarily dopamine-dependent tumors.
